questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] What is the most abundant gas in the Earth’s atmosphere?
A. Oxygen
B. Nitrogen
C. Carbon dioxide
Answer: B. Nitrogen makes up about 78% of the air we breathe. Nitrogen is a crucial part of the nitrogen cycle, which is essential for sustaining life on Earth by converting nitrogen in the atmosphere into forms that plants and animals can use.
questions.en: What is the most abundant gas in the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.de: Welches Gas kommt in der Erdatmosphäre am häufigsten vor?

timeline.labelEn: Daniel Rutherford discovers nitrogen, calling it “noxious air”
timeline.labelDe: Daniel Rutherford entdeckt den Stickstoff und nennt ihn „schädliche Luft“

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] How do ants breathe?
A. Through tiny holes
B. Through their legs
C. Through their mouths
Answer: A. Many insects breathe through tiny holes along their bodies, which are called spiracles. These openings connect to a network of tracheal tubes that deliver oxygen directly to their tissues.
questions.en: What are the tiny openings along an ant's body called, through which it breathes?
questions.de: Wie heißen die winzigen Öffnungen am Körper einer Ameise, durch die sie atmet?

timeline.labelEn: Sphecomyrma, among the earliest known ants, preserved in Cretaceous amber about 92 million years old
